decision_rationale: The record describes a multimodal large language model that integrates DNA, amino acid, and protein-structure embeddings with natural language queries and is fine-tuned on 370,000 QA pairs. That supports both a genuinely generative model and foundation-model-like broad applicability across multiple GO tasks.
evidence_snippet: "multimodal large language model that integrates embeddings from DNA sequences, amino acid sequences, and protein structures with natural language queries"; "Fine-tuned on over 370,000 question-answer pairs"; "answers queries regarding protein subcellular localization, molecular function, and biological processes"
